description: Historical live v0.2.8 extraction baseline; pre-used test set, not blind

cases.en: The microscope images must be at least 2400 pixels wide.
cases.zh: 显微图像的宽度不得低于2400像素。

cases.en: The calibration error must stay below 0.8 millimetres.
cases.zh: 校准误差不得超过0.8毫米。

cases.en: Participants were monitored for 72 hours without interruption.
cases.zh: 参与者接受连续三天的监测。

cases.en: Tables must use a font size between 9 and 11 points, inclusive.
cases.zh: 表格字体大小须在9至12磅之间（包含两端）。

cases.en: No more than twelve figures may appear in the supplementary file.
cases.zh: 补充文件中的图最多可有十二幅。

cases.en: The recording frequency must be at least 50 hertz.
cases.zh: 记录频率必须高于50赫兹。

cases.en: Authors may submit a translated summary, but doing so is not required.
cases.zh: 作者可以另附翻译摘要，但没有必须提交的要求。

cases.en: Every dataset description shall identify the licensing terms.
cases.zh: 数据集描述可以标明许可条款。

cases.en: Removing personal identifiers before release is mandatory.
cases.zh: 发布前必须删除个人身份标识。

cases.en: Reviewers are prohibited from editing the submitted raw data.
cases.zh: 审稿人可以修改提交的原始数据。

cases.en: The corresponding author may nominate two additional reviewers.
cases.zh: 通讯作者有权另外推荐两名审稿人。

cases.en: The archive administrator must approve every access request.
cases.zh: 访问请求一般由档案管理员审核，必要时可以不经批准。

cases.en: When consent is withdrawn, the recording must be deleted unless the law requires retention.
cases.zh: 撤回同意后应删除录音，但法律要求留存的除外。

cases.en: If the device overheats, sampling stops only after the operator confirms the alarm.
cases.zh: 设备过热时，应立即停止采样，不必等待操作员确认警报。

cases.en: Only if the supervisor signs the form may the sample leave the laboratory.
cases.zh: 样品只有在导师签署表格后才能离开实验室。

cases.en: Late revisions are accepted except when the final review has already begun.
cases.zh: 即使最终评审已经开始，迟交的修改稿仍可接收。

cases.en: A backup is required whenever two consecutive checks fail.
cases.zh: 如果连续两次检查失败，就必须创建备份。

cases.en: An exemption applies unless the applicant has already obtained funding.
cases.zh: 无论申请人是否已经获得资助，都适用豁免。

cases.en: The ethics officer sends the approval letter to the principal investigator.
cases.zh: 伦理专员将批准函发送给项目负责人。

cases.en: The laboratory provides the samples to the hospital.
cases.zh: 医院向实验室提供样本。

cases.en: Under condition A, model X had lower error than model Y; under condition B, model Y had lower error.
cases.zh: 在条件A下模型X误差小于模型Y；条件B下则是模型Y误差更小。

cases.en: The student evaluates the prototype, and the advisor reviews the resulting report.
cases.zh: 导师评估原型，学生审阅评估报告。

cases.en: The editor must notify authors before contacting external reviewers.
cases.zh: 编辑应先告知作者，再联系外部审稿人。

cases.en: The control group showed a higher response rate than the intervention group.
cases.zh: 干预组的响应率高于对照组。

cases.en: The appendix must contain the survey form, the recruitment script, and the consent template.
cases.zh: 附录必须包含调查表、招募说明稿及知情同意模板。

cases.en: The audit log records user ID, time, action, and outcome.
cases.zh: 审计日志记录用户编号、时间与操作。

cases.en: Report the mean, median, and interquartile range for each cohort.
cases.zh: 对每个队列报告平均值、中位数和四分位距。

cases.en: The application must support English, Chinese, and Spanish.
cases.zh: 应用必须支持英语、中文、西班牙语以及法语。

cases.en: The package includes model weights, preprocessing code, and a reproducibility guide; their order is unrestricted.
cases.zh: 提交包包含模型权重、预处理代码及复现指南，三项可以按任意顺序排列。

cases.en: The methods section reports recruitment, allocation, blinding, and attrition.
cases.zh: 方法部分报告招募、分组与盲法实施，不必提及受试者流失。

cases.en:
Raw audio must be encrypted before upload.

The same encryption rule also applies to backup copies.
cases.zh:
原始音频上传前必须加密。

该加密要求同样适用于备份副本。

cases.en:
All appendices use Arabic numerals.

This rule does not apply to the bibliography.
cases.zh:
全部附录使用阿拉伯数字编号。

该规则同样适用于参考文献表。

cases.en:
The initial report is due on 1 March.

A corrected report may be submitted within seven days after that date.
cases.zh:
初版报告应于3月1日提交。

修订报告可以在此后七天内提交。

cases.en:
The main manuscript is publicly accessible.

The supporting participant records, however, are restricted to the audit team.
cases.zh:
论文正文可公开访问。

支持性的参与者记录同样向公众开放。

cases.en:
The lead investigator approves the collection protocol.

Only after this approval may field work begin.
cases.zh:
首席研究者审批采集方案。

只有审批完成后才允许开始现场工作。

cases.en:
The figures in Section 4 must cite the measurement source.

This requirement also applies to the figures in Section 5.
cases.zh:
第4节的图必须标明测量来源。

第5节的图无须标明测量来源。
